item.description: The Sharks' Celebrini trying to keep Canada's streak intact; Americans look for first gold since Miracle on Ice in 1980.

item.title: Chalk Dog CrossFit to host adoption event and fundraising fitness competition on Feb. 28
item.description: Chalk Dog CrossFit will host a community Adoption Event and Fundraising Fitness Competition on Saturday, Feb. 28, bringing together fitness, philanthropy and animal advocacy in support of the Friends of Yolo County Animal Services (YCAS).

item.title: Yolo Bird Alliance offers a free field trip on March 7
item.description: Yolo Bird Alliance invites the public to join an engaging, hands-on birding field trip at the Putah Creek Riparian Reserve on Saturday, March 7, from 8 to 11 a.m., led by Zane Pickus and Emmett Iverson.

item.title: Pioneer High School boys soccer team wins CIF Sac-Joaquin Section Division III championship
item.description: The Pioneer High School boys varsity soccer team has etched its name in the history books, coming from one goal down to win the CIF Sac-Joaquin Section Division III championship game with a thrilling 3-1 victory over Valley Saturday morning at Cosumnes River College.

item.title: Woodland Christian boys soccer team wins CIF Sac-Joaquin Section Division VI championship
item.description: The Woodland Christian boys soccer team has made school history by winning the CIF Sac-Joaquin Section Division VI championship thanks to a 1-0 win over Millennium Saturday morning at Sacramento City College.

item.description: New Giants manager comes out of his first ever spring training game with some perspective following a 10-5 victory over the Seattle Mariners.
